name: agentic-dev-plugins
description: Public Claude Code plugins for agentic development workflows.

plugins.name: podman-sandbox
plugins.description: Run Claude Code in auto mode inside a Podman devcontainer, using a default-deny egress firewall as the real security boundary instead of per-directory prompts.

plugins.name: project-blueprint
plugins.description: Bootstrap and maintain projects to one blueprint: standard just commands, quality gates, trunk-based delivery and promote-by-dispatch deploys, across Python, Go, TypeScript and Rust.
